configurePresets.name: StandaloneRelease
configurePresets.description: Optimised standalone exe that must stay bit-exact with the Debug one. Needs `conan install . -s build_type=Release` (deps in build/Release/generators) first, and -DGTASA_PYTHON=<python>. See .notes/PHASE2_STATUS.md (StandaloneRelease).

configurePresets.name: StandaloneRW
configurePresets.displayName: Standalone (librw) Debug: the main development build and the base of the *_test targets
configurePresets.description: Debug twin of StandaloneRelease (build/StandaloneRW). Needs `conan install . -s build_type=Debug` (deps in build/Debug/generators) first, and -DGTASA_PYTHON=<python>. Windows: configure from the MSVC x86 shell (tools/standalone/windows/gtash.cmd). See docs/WINDOWS_SETUP.md.

configurePresets.name: StandaloneClangCL
configurePresets.displayName: StandaloneRelease compiled with clang-cl (--target=i686-pc-windows-msvc, MSVC STL + SDK headers): stream C compiler-portability check
configurePresets.description: Slice C1 of .notes/STREAM_C_PLAN.md. Run tools/standalone/clang-cl/make_generators.sh once (derives build/ClangCL/generators from build/Release/generators), then `cmake --preset StandaloneClangCL -DGTASA_PYTHON=<python>`. Needs `brew install llvm lld`. Compile-only target: `ninja -C build/StandaloneClangCL source/CMakeFiles/gta_reversed.dir/game_sa/<File>.cpp.obj`.

configurePresets.name: StandaloneDetached
configurePresets.displayName: StandaloneRelease + dev diagnostics: boot dump for tools/standalone/verify_globals.py and the original-image census (the only run config that maps the original data image)
configurePresets.description: Slices A2/A3/F3 of .notes/DETACH_DATA_PLAN.md. Same flags as StandaloneRelease (whose exe is image-less and relocatable), separate build dir, GTASA_VERIFY_GLOBALS=ON (run with NOTSA_VERIFY_GLOBALS=<file>) and GTASA_IMAGE_DIAG=ON (fixed base + 9 MB placeholder + original_data.bin/json next to the exe; NOTSA_IMAGE_CENSUS / NOTSA_POISON_CONVERTED). Dev-only: the one preset that needs the original exe (GTASA_ORACLE_EXE, extracts original_data.bin from it); fails to configure without it. StandaloneRelease / StandaloneRW need no exe at all.

configurePresets.name: PortableMac
configurePresets.displayName: Portable build, native macOS arm64 (Homebrew LLVM clang, libc++): GTASA_PORTABLE=ON, hook registry / Win32 startup / exe-oracle compiled out. Produces compile_commands.json for the C-0 census
configurePresets.description: Slices A-1 + C-0 of .notes/STREAM_C_PLAN.md. Run tools/portable/conan_install_mac.sh once (conan install from a scratch copy of conanfile.py into build/PortableMac/generators with conan/profiles/macos-arm64.txt: ConanPresets.json and source/libs/imgui are not touched), then `cmake --preset PortableMac`. Compiler: Homebrew LLVM (/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm, `brew install llvm`): its libc++ has std::views::enumerate / ranges::shift_right that Apple clang 21 lacks (MAC-C6 finding); the macOS SDK comes from CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT=macosx (cmake resolves it with xcrun and passes -isysroot; brew clang finds no C headers without it) and the executable links brew libc++ (-L/-rpath .../llvm/lib/c++). Apple clang 21 fallback: add -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/clang++ -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS= (it fails on enumerate / shift_right until shims exist). Render backend: librw GL3 + SDL3 (RW_GL3, no D3D9 defines); source/portable/winshim is on the include path for the direct <Windows.h> includers. The game does not compile on arm64 yet (streams P/W/F/R/C): the target is configured and its TUs are checked with `python3 tools/standalone/clang_census.py run --mode native --compdb build/PortableMac/compile_commands.json`, not linked.
